race.title: Virgin Bet November Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
race.verdict: The exciting ALFRED WINCHAM had so much in hand at York that even a 13 lb hike doesn't look enough to stop him. 2024 winner Lord Melbourne looks to have been targeted at this again and is feared most on the back of an encouraging run at York last month. Castle Cove has been absent since winning this last year but his good record fresh means it would come as no surprise were he to go well again. The reliable Say What You See should also have a say, while Nobody Knows is the unexposed one. ALFRED WINCHAM (IRE) LORD MELBOURNE (IRE) CASTLE COVE (IRE)
